column1: # Shared vectors for the exit-status icon the shell-drawn status segment uses:
# the theme's __icon_status_ok / __icon_status_fail when set (an EMPTY icon
# stays empty), else the nerd glyph, or the ASCII word when __prompt_icons
# asks for anything but `nerd`. Read by:
# Fish applies the same fallbacks once, when it initializes its icon globals
# (fish/core/init.fish), so it has no per-call function to feed these to.
# Format: one vector per line, tab-separated:
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored. In the three input
# columns the whole-column token \u means UNSET and \e means set-but-EMPTY; in
# the expected columns \e means the empty string. Everything else is literal.
# Every reader MUST fail if this file is missing or yields no vectors.
# Deliberately absent: an EMPTY __prompt_icons. Bash/Zsh treat it as `nerd`,
# Fish (any value but `nerd`) as ASCII; the theme export never sets it empty.
